title: armillary durable event envelope (v0.1)
description: The envelope every durable event MUST carry (constitution/instances.md I-2/I-3). Transient events reuse the shape with seq=0 and are never persisted. `data` is typed per event `type`; per-type payload schemas are a later version.

stream.description: Stream identifier, explicit on every event even when storage implies it (invariant i).

id.description: Event identity — MUST NOT be position-in-file (invariant ii).

seq.description: Monotonic within its stream (invariant iii — scope is the stream, not 'the session'). 0 = transient, never advances a cursor.

actor.description: Structured {role, instance} — never a free-form string.

type.description: Event type. Sovereign types (e.g. machine_verdict) confer authority the model cannot overwrite (instances.md S-1).

thread.description: First-class, optional, MAY span streams (invariant iv). Threads are concurrent, not alternatives.

parent.description: Reserved fork seam. Not a feature in v0.1.

cost.description: SHOULD carry size/cost so budgets and eviction can be computed without re-reading payloads.
